resources.string: One action, one tap. Point it at a light, a scene or a Magic Action.
Up to six of your actions on the home screen.
Fire a mapped controller button from any app

Lets a game-controller button you have mapped in TapRelay trigger its action while you are in another app, or on the home screen. TapRelay reads only the buttons you map; it does not read screen content and does not track what you do. Turn it off any time to stop.
